properties.description:
Recorded with add_epoch because it HAPPENED: the first item of the planned increment epoch:planned-the-mechanism-reaches-the-moment (sequence 490) landed on 2026-09-14, and the increment itself stays planned until the other two walks land. Sequence 491 places it inside that increment on the time axis.

WHAT ARRIVED. The root-cause walk on fact:reflow2-jargon-reaches-the-user-unfiltered-by-the-lens-a-work-session-said-structural-findings-and-undispositioned-drift-to-a-person, recorded as fact:root-cause-the-lens-rode-the-skill-rail-and-the-closing-words-are-chosen-on-the-loop-rail, and the fix at its cause: loop_status carries `lens`; every Stop-nudge message ends with the register line; the standing rule in served AGENTS.md names tool replies as addressed to the agent. Four server tests and one nudge test, each observed failing before the fix.

WHAT DID NOT ARRIVE, deliberately: the "every reply" clause of req:the-agent-learns-who-it-is-talking-to is still proposed and needs Anthony's word; the trial that would measure whether an agent's words are the reader's words is still unbuilt; the loop_hint on write replies still carries no lens (the cost question req:the-reminder-rides-the-response left open).
properties.name: ARRIVED 2026-09-14 — the lens rides loop_status and the Stop nudge says its words are for the agent: the first of the three field-report root-causes in epoch:planned-the-mechanism-reaches-the-moment delivered
